audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Mel at 3/10 in both layers while whys[4] says CHAAAARGE 'adds a knockback engage and gank-extension Mel has no dash to escape — force kills and roam'. The already-audited mirror (mel__kled) flipped that row to Kled and locked the chart as Mel, Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled.
audit.why: One row disagreed with its own why-line and with the mirror; every other row already matched.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Kled in both layers at 6/10. All other rows left untouched — they already match the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere. Solar Snare was 'her root / slow zone — dodge it' with no timer, and the reflect had none either.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s — the longest cooldown in her kit and by far the biggest punish window in the lane. Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s from 1000 range; Radiant Volley 10/9/8/7/6s from 950; Golden Eclipse 120/100/80s. Bear Trap is free on 11s, CHAAAARGE 140s.
audit.corrected: The 38s Rebuttal and the 11s/1000-range Solar Snare written into the cooldown block, the interactions row and the Do's/Don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the projectile reflect to Mel's ULTIMATE in six places ('bait her R reflect', 'her R reflect punishes a late all-in', 'turn your committed all-in back on you with her R damage/projectile reflect'). The reflect is Rebuttal, her W. Riot's R text — Golden Eclipse — strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm at any distance and reflects nothing. And nowhere does the page say the thing that matters most: Bear Trap is a projectile, so Rebuttal sends it straight back.
audit.why: A reader baiting a 120s ultimate that does not reflect, while opening every trade with a projectile into a 38s barrier that does, loses the lane on both counts.
audit.corrected: The reflect re-attributed to Rebuttal (W) with its 38s cooldown in whys[3], whys[6], wants.you[2], wants.foe[1], the interactions row and the cooldown block; the Bear-Trap-gets-reflected interaction stated outright. Golden Eclipse re-described as the Overwhelm execute it actually is.
sources: kit file mel W and R

audit.whatIsWrong: Three more strings claim Bear Trap deals percent-HP damage.
audit.why: Riot's Bear Trap text gives 'additional physical damage' when the shackle completes — there is no percent component in any Kled ability.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the shackle bonus in whys[5], spikes[3].text and wants.you[1].

notes: Biggest correction in this slice: six strings credited the projectile reflect to Mel's ULTIMATE. It is Rebuttal (W), 38s at rank 1, and because Bear Trap is a projectile it gets reflected straight back — an interaction that appeared nowhere on the page. Golden Eclipse is the global Overwhelm execute, not a reflect. Two long prose blocks (mid, late) still contain the 'her R reflect' error and the percent-HP Bear Trap claim; they need a follow-up pass. The page also refers to Mel as 'him/his' throughout the inherited boilerplate (enemyWin, tradeGood, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[2].t) — visible quality defect, outside my key points, left alone.
